title: 如何科学减肥？从身体调节说起

visualReview.conclusion: No new blocking issue in inspected samples. All low-motion flags were reviewed as readable explanation holds with local animation or slow camera motion.

audio.pronunciationMethod: Corrected TTS input and existing recognition/alignment checks, followed by final encoded waveform comparison. 120 uses 幺二零; LDL first introduces 低密度脂蛋白 and later voice uses the full Chinese term.

remainingMinorObservations.observation: A short angular dark fold/seam is visible across the front waistband during mid-rise. It does not expose sensitive geometry and is not present in the fully recovered standing view. Reported as a residual stylized garment limitation, not a new release blocker.

limitations: Sampled visual review, not complete frame-by-frame aesthetic certification.
Generic atlas and simplified garment shapes remain; the limited fork contact audit is not exhaustive collision simulation.
Molecular encounters and physiological flows are mechanism illustrations, not quantitative patient simulations.
